shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
cat .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"coverageThreshold|mock\\.calls\\.length|formatValidationError|errorPath|specs/hal-engine\" jest.config.* eslint.config.* scripts src | head -120
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,150p'
rg -n \"validated by:.*registry\\.test\" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Test valid tool input pass-through" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
